title: ZHX hub
features:
O QUE O SCRIPT FAZ / WHAT THE SCRIPT DOES:

1. Copiar Skin / Copy Skin — copia outfit inteira de outro player (roupa, acessório, cor, cara, animação, tamanho) / clones another player's full outfit (clothes, accessories, colors, face, animations, body size)

2. Resetar Skin / Reset Skin — volta sua skin original / restores your original skin

3. Ver Outfit / View Outfit — abre inspect da outfit de alguém / opens inspect view of someone's outfit

4. Dar Like / Give Like — curte outfit de um player ou de todos / likes one player's outfit or everyone's

5. RGB no Corpo / Body RGB — pinta o boneco com cores animadas, 3 modos / paints your character with animated colors, 3 modes:

Suave / Smooth (arco-íris / rainbow)

Aleatório / Random (cada parte uma cor / each part a different color)

Custom (gradiente entre 2 cores escolhidas / gradient between 2 chosen colors)

6. Color Picker — seletor de cor HSV com histórico / HSV color picker with history

7. Escolher Partes / Choose Parts — bonequinho clicável pra ligar/desligar RGB em cada parte / clickable dummy to toggle RGB on each part (cabeça, braço, perna / head, arm, leg...)

8. Body Scaling — muda tamanho do corpo de 1% a 100% / changes body size from 1% to 100% (altura, largura, cabeça / height, width, head...)

9. Animação Troll / Troll Animation — loopa animação de zoeira (R6 e R15) com controle de velocidade / loops a troll animation (R6 and R15) with speed control

10. Players — lista de jogadores, busca, teleportar até alguém, add/remover amigo, bloquear / player list, search, teleport to someone, add/remove friend, block

11. Ragdoll — deixa o boneco mole no chão / makes your character go limp on the floor

12. Extras — like em todo mundo, ragdoll / like everyone, ragdoll

13. UI — tela de loading com música, janela arrastável, relógio, 5 abas, sons, TTS falando quando clica na logo, funciona no celular / loading screen with music, draggable window, clock, 5 tabs, sounds, TTS speaking when clicking the logo, works on mobile

IMPORTANTE / IMPORTANT: é script de exploit, só roda em executor tipo Synapse/Krnl. Funciona só em jogos que tenham os remotes específicos (tipo Catalog Avatar Creator) / it's an exploit script, only runs in executors like Synapse/Krnl. Only works in games that have the specific remotes (like Catalog Avatar Creator).
